scope: Source-conditioned P3 reconstruction development; not Wu-Vallet reproduction, source authority, or a proposed-method efficacy result
parameter_basis: Predeclared engineering diagnostic settings; 0.15 m is a displacement cap, not a calibrated source accuracy bound. Equal 384 steps and view order. No reference tuning. Normal changes test sensitivity to RGB fitting, not certified geometric detail recovery.
limits: All selected views and the exact937 MVS have historical development use

Native voxel-selected points initialize Gaussians; Gaussian centers are not extracted surfaces
